writers.name: parties
writers.brief: Book the old parties concept into books/as-is/parties/: data.ts (every table and state machine), procedures.ts (its door; many files already import parties procedures by name), one file per area folder (verifications, contacts, destinations, accounts, recipients, and any other area), flows.ts (packages/sdk/src/parties/), index.ts.

writers.name: books
writers.brief: Book the old books concept into books/as-is/books/: data.ts (bookCharts, bookAccounts, bookAssignments, bookFacts, bookKeepers, bookPrices, bookAssets, bookCursors and any others, with machines), procedures.ts (its door: classifyRow, recordSettledPaymentInTx, the reversal and claim functions and the rest), one file per area folder (facts, assets, exports, postings, keepers, reports, accounts), flows.ts (packages/sdk/src/books/), index.ts. Include the observe, backfill, prices and outside-money workflows. Two partial files from a stopped writer are in the folder: overwrite them.

writers.name: small-a
writers.brief: Book four small old concepts, each in its own folder with data.ts, procedures.ts, one file per area, flows.ts and index.ts as the conventions say: activity (areas overlays, items, annotations, documents), profiles (onboardings, details; many files import profiles procedures and table_identities by name), media (images), documents (its areas and its door, which payments and requests call heavily).

writers.name: permissions-allowances
writers.brief: Book the old permissions concept, part two, into books/as-is/permissions/: one file per area for allowances, replacements and commands (every operation as an rpc or workflow), and flows-allowances.ts (packages/sdk/src/permissions/ methods for these areas that compose several calls; permissions/flows.ts and operations/governance.ts already expect flow_client_org_allowances_create, change, assign and revoke from it). Part one is already written: import tables and machines from ./data.ts and procedures from ./procedures.ts by conventional names; index.ts already lists your files.

writers.name: shared-events
writers.brief: Extend books/as-is/shared/vocabulary.ts so it books every product event in the old catalog (packages/observability/src/catalog/ and packages/observability/src/events/), not only payments' events: one event record per catalog event, with its property schema. Many concept files already import event_<name> records that do not exist yet: define every one that is a real catalog event, and list in your report any expected name that is not in the catalog. KEEP every existing error and event record unchanged. Check that every code in packages/protocol/src/errors/codes.ts and every concept's error-codes.ts is booked, and add any missing.

writers.name: ops-equity-orgs
writers.brief: Write books/as-is/operations/equity.ts and books/as-is/operations/organizations.ts: one operation record for every operation the old book lists in apps/docs/factory/areas/equity.yaml and organizations.yaml, built from the frozen text as the conventions say. Trace each CLI command to its SDK method; implementedBy = its flow when it composes several calls, else the one rpc it reaches (conventional names; organizations is already booked in books/as-is/organizations/); returns from the protocol row; refusals mapped to errors with worlds from packages/scenarios, else "?"; errors = what the CLI produces itself. Many equity operations are designed for v4 but never built: list every operation with no implementation in your report and say so in its about.
